# React Native Background Location

> Cross-platform React Native TurboModule library for background location tracking on Android and iOS.

## Package

- npm: @gabriel-sisjr/react-native-background-location
- Repository: https://github.com/gabriel-sisjr/react-native-background-location
- Documentation: https://gabriel-sisjr.github.io/react-native-background-location/

## Overview

A React Native library that provides background location tracking using TurboModules (New Architecture). Supports Android (foreground service + Room DB) and iOS (CLLocationManager + Core Data). Features include real-time location updates, geofencing with ENTER/EXIT/DWELL transitions, crash recovery, persistent storage, configurable notifications, and opt-in motion activity (activity events plus an optional reduction of location updates while the device is stationary; off by default).

## Requirements

- React Native >= 0.73.0
- React >= 18.2.0
- TurboModules (New Architecture) enabled
- Android: min SDK 24, target SDK 34
- iOS: 16.0+
- Expo (optional): SDK 54+ with a development build, see /docs/guides/expo-config-plugin
- Motion activity (optional): Google Play services on Android (the app declares ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION, which Google Play treats as health-related sensitive data: prominent disclosure and user consent before requesting it, Health apps declaration, Data safety "Health and fitness > Fitness info" when motion-derived data leaves the device; see /docs/production/google-play-compliance); on iOS the Podfile flag `$BackgroundLocationMotionActivity = true` plus `NSMotionUsageDescription`; see /docs/guides/motion-activity

## Public API

### Tracking Functions
- `startTracking(tripIdOrOptions?, options?)` — Start background location tracking. Returns trip ID. The trip ID is positional (`startTracking('trip-1', { ... })`).
- `stopTracking()` — Stop tracking and terminate the service.
- `isTracking()` — Check if tracking is active. Returns `TrackingStatus`.
- `getLocations(tripId)` — Retrieve stored locations for a trip.
- `clearTrip(tripId)` — Delete all stored data for a trip.
- `updateNotification(title, text)` — Update Android notification while tracking.

### Geofencing Functions
- `addGeofence(region)` — Register a single geofence.
- `addGeofences(regions)` — Register multiple geofences atomically.
- `removeGeofence(identifier)` — Remove a geofence by identifier.
- `removeGeofences(identifiers)` — Remove multiple geofences.
- `removeAllGeofences()` — Remove all active geofences.
- `getActiveGeofences()` — List all active geofences.
- `getMaxGeofences()` — Get platform geofence limit (Android: 100, iOS: 20).
- `getGeofenceTransitions(identifier?)` — Retrieve stored transition events.
- `clearGeofenceTransitions(identifier?)` — Clear stored transitions.
- `configureGeofenceNotifications(options)` — Configure geofence notification settings.
- `getGeofenceNotificationConfig()` — Get current geofence notification config.

### Motion Activity Functions
- `addMotionActivityListener(listener)` — Subscribe to `onMotionActivity` events. Returns `{ remove() }`.
- `checkMotionPermission()` — Motion permission status without prompting. Returns `MotionPermissionStatus`.
- `requestMotionPermission()` — Request the motion permission (Android 10+ dialog, iOS Motion & Fitness prompt in the foreground; iOS resolves UNDETERMINED when the user has not answered). Call before `startTracking`, after the user accepted your motion disclosure (Google Play).
- `getMotionActivityState()` — Snapshot `{ tripId, detection, reduction, lastActivity }` of the current session.

### React Hooks
- `useBackgroundLocation(options?)` — Full tracking control with trip management.
- `useLocationTracking(options?)` — Lightweight tracking status monitoring.
- `useLocationUpdates(options?)` — Real-time location event stream.
- `useLocationPermissions()` — Cross-platform permission management.
- `useGeofencing(options?)` — Geofence CRUD operations.
- `useGeofenceEvents(options?)` — Real-time geofence transition listener.
- `useGeofencePermissions()` — Alias for useLocationPermissions.
- `useMotionActivity(options?)` — Motion activity events plus detection and reduction status (read-only). Refreshes on mount, app resume, `MOTION_*` warnings and the first event of a session; call `refresh()` after `stopTracking()`.

### Enums
- `LocationAccuracy` — HIGH_ACCURACY, BALANCED_POWER_ACCURACY, LOW_POWER, NO_POWER, PASSIVE
- `NotificationPriority` — LOW, DEFAULT, HIGH, MAX
- `LocationPermissionStatus` — GRANTED, WHEN_IN_USE, DENIED, BLOCKED, UNDETERMINED
- `NotificationPermissionStatus` — GRANTED, DENIED, UNDETERMINED
- `GeofenceTransitionType` — ENTER, EXIT, DWELL
- `GeofenceErrorCode` — INVALID_REGION, DUPLICATE_IDENTIFIER, LIMIT_EXCEEDED, MONITORING_FAILED, NOT_AVAILABLE, PERMISSION_DENIED, PLAY_SERVICES_UNAVAILABLE
- `MotionActivityType` — STATIONARY, WALKING, RUNNING, CYCLING, AUTOMOTIVE, UNKNOWN
- `MotionConfidence` — LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH
- `MotionPermissionStatus` — GRANTED, DENIED, UNDETERMINED, UNAVAILABLE
- `MotionDetectionStatus` — OFF, RUNNING, UNAVAILABLE, PERMISSION_NOT_GRANTED
- `MotionReductionStatus` — DISABLED, NOT_APPLICABLE, UNAVAILABLE, MONITORING, REDUCED

### Key Types
- `TrackingOptions` — Configuration for tracking (updateInterval, accuracy, distanceFilter, notificationOptions, motionActivity, etc.)
- `MotionActivityOptions` / `MotionReductionOptions` — Opt-in motion activity and the reduction of location updates while stationary (sampleInterval, reduceWhenStationary, stationaryDelay, automotiveCooldown, maxReducedDuration, notificationText)
- `MotionActivityEvent` — Motion activity event (tripId, activity, confidence, timestamp)
- `LocationWarningEvent` — Warning (type, message, tripId, timestamp); 11 `LocationWarningType` members including the four MOTION_* warnings
- `Coords` — Location coordinate data (latitude, longitude, timestamp, accuracy, altitude, speed, bearing)
- `TrackingStatus` — Active status and trip ID
- `GeofenceRegion` — Geofence definition (identifier, lat/lng, radius, transitionTypes)
- `GeofenceTransitionEvent` — Transition event data
- `NotificationOptions` — Android notification configuration
- `GeofenceError` — Custom error class for geofence operations
